a: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.
A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.
Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.
Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.
Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.
Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.
Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.
Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.
The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.
Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.
Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.
The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.
Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.
Blood Boil 10 s, Flock of Ravens 15 s then 33 s, Blood Siphon 6-8 s and Lunar Shift 25 s come from creature_spells 619390, a one-line tw_world dump.
Ravens take damage only from players with Blue Moon (51080); the first half of the raid gets Red Moon (51081) and the rest Blue Moon at the pull, and Lunar Shift swaps the two and resets 100% threat.

66.6 and 33.3 percent: Worgen Dimension (51096) makes him immune to all attacks and spells, and two Blue plus two Red Owls spawn at fixed points with a 60 s timed despawn. The dimension ends only after four owl DEATHS, so owls not killed within 60 s despawn without counting and leave him immune.
51087 Owl Gaze is bound to an aura script but no tw_world creature or spell list casts it.

Summon Ley-Seeker (45-55 s), Summon Whelps (30-35 s), Ley-Line Disturbance (30 s) and Blizzard (14-17 s) start only after all four Ley-Seekers die; Gaze runs from the pull (7 s then 30-35 s), and Arcane Missiles and Guided Ley-Beam share one 8-12 s timer.
Every Ley-Line Disturbance summons one random Affinity; it dies 15 s later, and one still alive Berserks the boss (26662) first. Affinities are immune to every school but their own.
Below 40 percent Curse of Manascale is added every 13 s; the other abilities keep running.
Manascale Whelp 59955 is not in the current creature dump (the template has 59988 Manascale Whelp); the Ley-Seeker's own spells are 51175 Surge of Mana and 51177 Arcane Explosion.
While a Ley-Seeker lives it channels 51187 on the boss; each summoned Affinity channels it too.
Repeats are 15 s, 24 s and 9 s times max(30, health percent)/100, so they shorten as he dies (4.5, 7.2 and 2.7 s at 30 percent).

Overload, Unstable Magic and Prison walk the threat list and take the first eligible player: the highest-threat non-victim who has none of 51100, 51101 or 51107 (the data's t=random is the nearest label).
On overload expiry the player casts 51099 Arcane Bomb and 51101 Arcane Dampening on itself with Anomalus as the original caster.
Manabound Strikes 51105 is applied by the passive aura 51106 and 51098 pulses 51097 around the boss; neither has a cast event.
Unstable Magic Zone 59996 takes no damage and dies after 8 s, so nothing kills it (kill priority 0): it needs a soaker within 8 yd, or on death every player within 200 yd takes 51104.

Six spells are picked at random (plus Shadow Bolt in shadowform, Shadebolt otherwise) and cast whenever the boss is not already casting; there is no timer. None is flagged interruptible: do not interrupt him.
Gaze of the Guardian is first cast 20-25 s after the pull, then every 20-25 s.
Do not interrupt him: every interrupt effect adds a Guardian's Ire stack, and 4 stacks cast Medivh's Fury.
At 80, 50 and 20 percent one Unstoppable Infernal is summoned; 50 percent adds Shadowform; 20 percent adds Enrage and Medivhs Fury.
While shadowformed a Shade of Medivh is summoned every 10 s; Shadow Bolt 51122 also summons one through its spell effect.
The Shade casts 24668 Shadow Bolt; the Infernal casts 51124 Charge of Flame then 51123 Pulse of Fire (creature_spells 599940 and 599950, one-line dumps).
When a Bishop, Rook or Knight dies the King casts Kings Fury 51229 on himself, and he removes Invulnerability 51228 when he is the only piece left.
Pawns Advance (51210, aura script) recalculates each pawns weapon damage from the number of nearby pawns every second.
Void Zone 28863 summons a persistent object (spell effect 41), a damaging area the schema cannot flag as ground.
The Kings creature template carries aura 51228 and spell list 599670, but there is no creature_spells row for 599670: every King cast comes from the script.
Summon Pawn is first cast 8-14 s after the pull and Kings Curse 40-50 s; both keep their random window afterward.

Heal 51214 goes to a pawn below 75% health within 40 yd; Redemption 51216 only fires after the Knight is dead, on a dead Pawn within 40 yd (it brings it back to life); Silence 51217 only after the Rook is dead, on a random mana user.
Shadow Bolt is 51212 within 10 yd of the Bishop and Empowered Shadow Bolt 51213 beyond; Episcopacy 51218 is cast once the Bishop is the only piece left.
Fortify 51221 only fires after the Bishop is dead; Siege Equipment 51223 only after the Knight is dead; Shield Bash 51219 and Advance 51220 halve their repeats when the Rook is the only piece left.
Episcopacy 51218 is cast once the Rook is the only piece left.

Trample 51226 only fires after the Rook is dead; Summon Ghastly Horseman 51227 only after the Bishop is dead, and when the Knight is the only piece it is every 10-15 s and summons three at once; Glorious Cleave 51225 every 1.3 s.
Knights Glory 51224 is cast at spawn; Episcopacy 51218 is cast once the Knight is the only piece left.
The four normal abilities pause between 80 and 50 percent: only Overflowing Hatred and the portals run, and they resume at 50 percent.

Overflowing Hatred: first 6 s after 80 percent, every 8.5 s until 50 percent, then the first cast after 50 percent comes 55 s later, then every 30-37 s; Rift Feedback: first 60 s after 50 percent, then every 45 s.
51204 leaves the aura that triggers 51203; each tick deals 6000 fire to players around the targets and Rift Feedback deals 12000 arcane.
Opening the Rift also summons a Rift-Lost Draenei every second through 51208 (misc 59975).
The three portals are script summons at fixed points; each summons Rift-Lost, Shadow-Lost or Netherwalker every 7 s and a Riftwalker or Riftstalker every 30-50 s.
A Draenei Riftwalker casts 51199 on a friendly, turning it into a Rift Elemental 59974 and killing both.
No script, no spell list and no EventAI: this core gives him only health and melee (1,230,919 health, 7811-9201 damage), so his fight is not implemented in this checkout.

The four Crumbling Exiles 59960 carry spell list 599600: 51283 Rupture (physical damage and -11% hit chance) every 15-25 s, 51284 Shifting Rock (+3000 armor) every 30-45 s, 51286 Molten Surge (charge for fire damage and a stun) every 7-15 s; aura 51285 Splintered Exile deals 150 physical damage to attackers when hit.
Mark of the Highlord goes to up to 3 random mana users; each tick casts 51165 Shadow Nova from the player with Kruul as the original caster.
Before 25 percent Mark repeats every 30 s and Call goes on the victim every 25 s; after 25 percent Mark is 15 s, Call 15 s on a random player and Void Bolt Volley 10 s.

Wings of Oblivion knocks players back and applies Wrath of the Highlord 51173; Remorseless Strikes replaces his melee swing and each hit stacks a 10% damage-taken debuff (aura 87, up to 99 stacks): tank swap.
The summoned Infernal is rooted (22707) and gets Inferno Effect 51167; its Hellfire Aura 51169 burns nearby players.
